Liam: Quick shoutout  Verdant Payments is live via the AWS Marketplace ISV Private Offer on Redwood Dedicated (us-east-1) as of 13:40 UTC. Huge team effort. :tada:
Noor: Amazing! Any early perf/cost signals?
Grace: Early numbers: p95 latency for transaction-normalization calls ~130ms at 180 req/s. Token infra cost down ~49% after int8 quantization + KV prefix caching.
InfraBot: deployment/verdant-payments/marketplace succeeded at 13:40:56 (duration 102s) :white_check_mark:
Liam: Deploy trace:
```
[13:38:30] provision pool: vp-ded-02
[13:39:10] deploy model: redwood-gpt-7b-1.1
[13:40:10] canary 10% -> health ok
[13:40:56] promote -> 100% traffic
[13:41:05] post-checks ok
```
PartnerOps: Customer requested a 1-paragraph case blurb + one metric for the marketplace tile. Also requesting permission to publish their name & logo.
Grace: Draft blurb: "Verdant Payments reduced inference costs by ~49% and improved p95 tail latency for transaction normalization workflows after moving to Redwood Dedicated via the AWS Marketplace, enabled by dedicated pools and KV prefix caching."
Noor: Good. Add model mention (`redwood-gpt-7b-1.1`) and call out cross-region DR to us-west-2.
Legal: Please obtain written permission before publishing customer name/quote. Use the standard permission template.
Liam: I'll drop perf graphs and the short config snippet here in 30m for marketing assets.
Grace: Config snippet:
```
deployment:
  mode: dedicated
  pool: vp-ded-02
  model: redwood-gpt-7b-1.1
  batching: latency-aware
  kv_cache: prefix
  quantization: int8
```
PartnerOps: Thanks everyone. Once legal signs off, I'll coordinate the public case tile and marketplace highlight. Planning an exec sync with the account team next week to surface cost delta and SLA notes.
Liam: Big win  sharing to #all-hands and #partners after permissions confirmed. :clap:
